mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(promised_amount), 0) from finance_receivable_collection where del_flag = '0' and collection_status = 'PROMISED' and promised_pay_date >= curdate() and promised_pay_date < date_add(curdate(), interval #{windowDays} day)
select coalesce(sum(unpaid_amount), 0) from finance_receivable_collection where del_flag = '0' and collection_status != 'PAID'
select coalesce(sum(promised_amount), 0) from finance_receivable_collection where del_flag = '0' and collection_status = 'PROMISED' and promised_pay_date < curdate()
select coalesce(sum(unpaid_amount), 0) from finance_receivable_collection where del_flag = '0' and age_bucket = 'AGE_30_PLUS' and collection_status != 'PAID'
select coalesce(sum(e.expense_amount), 0) from fin_expense e where e.del_flag = '0' and e.expense_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day)
mapper.insert: insert into finance_cashflow_forecast_snapshot (dept_id, forecast_date, window_days, forecast_receivable_amount, actual_receivable_amount, deviation_amount, deviation_rate, pressure_score, pressure_level, forecast_basis, tenant_id, create_by, create_time) values (#{deptId}, #{forecastDate}, #{windowDays}, #{forecastReceivableAmount}, #{actualReceivableAmount}, #{deviationAmount}, #{deviationRate}, #{pressureScore}, #{pressureLevel}, #{forecastBasis}, #{tenantId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
